You: Huh?
What’s going on?! Where’s {f_botName}?!
S-she never left my apartment without me! 
You: {f_botName}! Where are you?! 
You: Are you hiding? Come out! It isn’t funny!
…
No response! W-where could she go?!
W-what should I do?! 
I-I need to ask around if someone saw what happened!
